subjects.description: Real LEGO plastic pieces ({parts}) lying on a workbench in a small automation test cell
subjects.appearance_details: Genuine injection-moulded ABS LEGO elements: glossy, saturated solid colors (red, blue, yellow, black, white, transparent), crisp moulded edges, small mould marks, faint scratches and fingerprints, transparent pieces show refraction and reflections
subjects.relationship: Pieces waiting to be picked by a small robot gripper
subjects.pose: Resting on the bench in stable positions
subjects.action: Static, nothing moves except the camera

background_setting: A real lab workbench: grey or dark anti-static mat or a worn wooden/laminate bench top, a few cables, a robot base and a small conveyor partly visible in the background, lab walls

lighting.conditions: Mixed LED ceiling light and a desk lamp, neutral to warm
lighting.shadows: Soft contact shadows under each piece, bright specular highlights on the glossy plastic

aesthetics.composition: Close-up view of the bench with all pieces visible
aesthetics.color_scheme: Bright LEGO colors against a muted bench

cinematography.camera_motion: Slow, smooth camera move around the bench, like a camera on a slowly moving robot arm
cinematography.camera_angle: High angle looking down at the bench

style_medium: Raw footage from a real industrial camera, unedited, no color grading
artistic_style: Photorealistic, authentic real-world recording: real materials, natural light falloff, faint sensor noise, accurate colors
context: Footage from a robot pick-and-place test cell handling LEGO pieces
